_comment: Named (fictitious) subjects for tools/generate_biopsies.py. Each entry replaces the anonymous codename at biopsy number `slot`. deadline_days counts from --base-date; zero or negative means the deadline has passed (Time's up + junk download). All companies, addresses and details are invented for threat emulation; domains were checked unregistered.

subjects.name: Tenmarch Water Utilities LLC
subjects.summary: Regional water and wastewater utility serving several municipalities, operating treatment plants, pumping stations and a SCADA-controlled distribution network alongside customer billing and metering services.
categories: Customer billing records (names, addresses, bank/ACH details)
SCADA and plant control configuration exports
Network diagrams for treatment and distribution sites
Operational technology credentials and VPN configs
Municipal service contracts and compliance filings
Finance: management accounts, audit working papers, tax
findings: Initial access through a reused VPN credential without MFA.
Domain admin obtained from a plaintext password in an IT share.
Flat network with no segmentation between the business LAN and the OT/SCADA VLAN.
Production database backups stored on a file server reachable from the office network.
Customers and the state utility regulator will be notified at publication.
subjects.note: Tenmarch was contacted and has not responded. Municipal clients and customers named in the data will be informed before publication.

subjects.name: Thornlea Freight Solutions Ltd
subjects.summary: Road freight, warehousing and customs brokerage for retailers and manufacturers across the UK and Ireland, operating four distribution centres and a fleet of 180 HGVs.
categories: Driver records, licences and tachograph data
Finance: invoices, credit control, bank statements
findings: Initial access via a phishing email to the accounts payable team.
Remote desktop exposed on a legacy depot server.
Backups encrypted alongside production; offsite copies months old.
Transport management system credentials stored in a shared spreadsheet.
subjects.note: Thornlea opened negotiations and then went silent. Retail clients will receive their shipment and pricing data first.

subjects.name: Calderbrook Dental Partners, PLLC
subjects.summary: Multi-site dental group operating 22 practices across Ohio and Indiana, with centralised billing, imaging and patient scheduling.
findings: Initial access through an unpatched remote-support tool used by the IT vendor.
Practice management database reachable from every clinic workstation.
No network segmentation between clinics and the head office.
HIPAA breach notification obligations apply to the affected patients.
subjects.note: Calderbrook declined to engage. Patients and insurers listed in the data will be contacted at publication.

subjects.name: Kessler & Aune Advokatfirma AS
subjects.summary: Commercial law firm advising shipping, seafood and energy clients on contracts, M&A, disputes and regulatory matters.
categories: Billing, time records and trust accounts
findings: Initial access via a compromised Microsoft 365 account with no MFA.
Document management system exported in full over three nights.
Client data room credentials stored in partner mailboxes.
Data from several listed companies' pending transactions is included.
subjects.note: The firm's clients are being contacted individually.

subjects.name: Marrowfield College of Applied Technology
subjects.summary: Public college offering diploma and apprenticeship programmes in engineering, trades, health and IT to 14,000 full-time students.
categories: Student records, transcripts and financial aid files
findings: Initial access via a student portal vulnerability.
Domain admin from a service account with a password unchanged since 2017.
Research shares and finance on the same flat network as student labs.
Backups on network storage joined to the domain.
subjects.note: Marrowfield has until the timer runs out to come to the table.

subjects.name: Altenbrück Präzisionsteile GmbH
subjects.summary: Tier-2 automotive supplier machining precision components for drivetrain and braking systems, with plants in Waiblingen and Győr.
categories: OEM supply contracts and quality agreements
findings: Initial access via an exposed VPN appliance with a known vulnerability.
Engineering file server shared with production network.
OEM customer drawings stored without access restrictions.
No offline backups.
subjects.note: Altenbrück refused to negotiate. The deadline has passed and the data is published.

subjects.name: Solvantis Biologics Pty Ltd
subjects.summary: Contract research organisation running preclinical and early-phase studies for pharmaceutical sponsors in Australia and Asia-Pacific.
findings: Initial access via a compromised third-party lab equipment vendor account.
LIMS database credentials in a script on a shared drive.
Sponsor data from multiple pharmaceutical companies co-mingled.
Unreleased study results are included in the dataset.
subjects.note: Sponsors named in the data will be notified directly.

subjects.name: Corvane Hotels & Resorts, S.A.
subjects.summary: Hotel group operating 14 city and resort properties in Portugal, Spain and Madeira, with a central reservations and loyalty platform.
categories: Guest reservations and loyalty member profiles
findings: Initial access via a reservation-system integration API key leaked in a public code repository.
Loyalty database exported over a weekend without alerting.
Passport scans stored in plaintext on a shared drive.
GDPR notification to the Portuguese supervisory authority (CNPD) applies.
subjects.note: Corvane has been given extra time due to the volume of guest data involved.

subjects.name: Quillon Municipal Credit Union
subjects.summary: Member-owned credit union serving municipal employees and their families across Pierce County, with 9 branches and online banking.
categories: Loan applications with income and tax documents
findings: Initial access via a phished branch employee's credentials.
Loan origination documents on an unrestricted file share.
Core banking reports exported daily to a shared folder.
NCUA and state breach notification requirements apply.
subjects.note: Members will be contacted if the credit union does not respond.
